name: Postor Bora
instructions: 1. Soak poppy seeds in water for 30 minutes, then drain and grind into a smooth paste with green chilies.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine the poppy seed paste, chopped onion, turmeric powder, salt, and rice flour.
3. Mix well to form a thick, moldable batter.
4. Heat mustard oil in a pan over medium heat.
5. Shape small portions of the mixture into flat discs or patties.
6. Drop into the hot oil and fry until both sides are crispy and golden brown.
7. Serve hot as a side dish with steamed rice.
description: Postor Bora is a beloved traditional fritter in the Bengali-influenced cuisine of Tripura. Poppy seeds are highly valued for their delicate, nutty flavor, and these crispy cakes are a quintessential comfort food often served at the beginning of a meal with dal and rice.
